definitions: Any of various plants of the genus Asphodelus, native to the Mediterranean region, having white, pink, or yellow flowers.
A plant of the lily family, especially the common asphodel (Asphodelus albus), with white flowers.
In classical mythology, a flower said to cover the Elysian Fields.
examples: The asphodel bloomed in the garden.
The poet wrote of fields of asphodel.
